rule: after the v11 strict guard, only an incomplete prompt-visible tie between two executable drafts may be reconsidered; mask each existing disagreement block under both complete draft contexts and switch to original LLaDA only when the symmetric verifier supports it

development.promotion_gate: strictly more correct than v11 and method-only greater than parent-only

formal_holdout.inspection_status: no per-record verifier analysis before registration
formal_holdout.promotion_gate: strictly more correct than v11, at least one method-only recovery, and parent-only no greater than method-only

cross_dataset_behavior.MATH-500: exact v9/v11 fallback because there are no public Python checks
cross_dataset_behavior.MBPP: a failed public-assertion tie cannot convert an incorrect parent into an officially correct answer; the verifier is therefore not expected to alter the v11 correctness ceiling
